title: Pod → service auth: projected token vs Vault vs SPIFFE
summary: Three ways a pod proves who it is to something that isn't a cloud API. All three start from the pod's service account; they differ in who checks it and what the pod receives.

dimensions.label: Pod presents
values: SA token at login, then a Vault token

dimensions.label: Works outside Kubernetes
values: Receiver can be anywhere; caller must be a pod
Yes: VMs, other clusters, federated domains

notes: Projected tokens underpin both of the others: Vault and SPIRE (node attestation) consume them.
Prefer the receiver checking an audience-bound token offline over sharing a static API key.
